posts.cooked:
Spiff:

k, I'll sit here and hope that I don't have to sign up for some other site to find out about stuff going on with this one.  I'm sure someone will cross-post.

From what I've seen nothin to cross post at the moment craig put up the link to the picture that reveals purple legs and a machine gun… As much as I love pretty much every product that GtG has done the handling of Dev Journal has been very lacking to my taste these last few months. Now I'm usually a sucker for foreshadowing and teasing audience with content, but you'd figure that after 2 months of absolute no developpers journal and no update on bios for Infinitor (BTW the only way to know that name for non playtesters is still to have looked at the preorder image with tiltle deck in it) and Progeny. This corner of a picture falls really flat as far as I'm concerned. Actually was more excited when Braithwhite posted the shadow on the chairman card.

So hopefully we get bios on remaining villains before the game ships…
